title: Delegation
description: What a delegation's run has come to, as the daemon reads it when a client asks for the view DelegationResult: one row per run that a Delegate created. The route, the path and the protocol are the run's event `runbook.delegated`, and for a delegation the daemon classified its event `runbook.delegation-resolved` (path, protocol, confidence, classifier route and the digest of a generated protocol, recorded when the run started); the state, the outcome and the failure are the Run's; the calls, the tokens and the cost are the sum of the run's events `runbook.model-call` (one per call the relay booked); the result text is the file result.md of the run's work/ directory, read through the reader of ProductOfRun (no link followed, at most `result_limit` bytes), and the products are the paths ProductsOfRun lists. The language cannot read a file system, so no command creates or changes a row, as with RunProducts.

run_state.description: Where the run stands. Not `state`: that member of an entity is its lifecycle, and no command moves a row of this one.

outcome.description: The run's outcome once it Ended.

failure.description: Why the run failed to start, or what failed it after it started (the runtime's reason, or the step whose program failed and how it ended: its exit, its signal or its timeout); absent otherwise.

route.description: The model route of the run, by name.

route_phase.description: The last phase the gateway gave of a route of the run that could not answer: set while the run waits for its route and when it ended `stopped: route`; absent for a run that never waited.

path.description: Absent while the daemon classifies the delegation (from its submit until its run starts, or fails to).

protocol.description: The protocol the run runs, by the id its document declares: the named runbook, delegation-free, the runbook the classifier picked, or the id of the generated protocol; absent while the path is.

confidence.description: The classifier's confidence, a number from 0 to 1, for a classified or generated delegation; null for the paths named and free.

classifier_route.description: The route of the classify and build calls, by name, for a delegation the daemon classified.

protocol_digest.description: sha256:<hex> of the protocol document the builder wrote, for a generated delegation.

repository.description: The repository a delegation of the path change changes, by the name of its entry in the daemon's runbook.toml.

branch.description: For the path change, once the run delivered and the daemon pushed its change: the branch, runbook/<run-id>, a new ref of the entry's remote.

commit.description: The commit the daemon pushed as the branch: one commit on the entry's base, by the entry's identity.

handback_refused.description: For the path change, once the run delivered: why the daemon pushed nothing (the worktree's .git file was changed, no change, a path of the entry's deny_paths, or git's own words for a push it refused, such as a branch that exists already).

result_text.description: The text of result.md in the run's work/ directory, at most `result_limit` bytes; absent while the run has written none, and for a file that is not text.

result_truncated.description: True when result.md holds more than `result_limit` bytes: `result_text` is its start.

result_limit.description: The most bytes of result.md the view answers: 1048576.

products.description: The paths of the files of the run's work/ directory, as ProductsOfRun lists them.

calls.description: The model calls the relay booked for the run.

input_tokens.description: The input tokens those calls reported; a call that reported none adds 0.

cost_micro_usd.description: What the calls booked: the route's declared price times the tokens, else the reservation of a call of unknown cost.

cost_known.description: False when any call was booked at its reservation because its cost was not known.

sdc.daemon.DelegationId.title: DelegationId
sdc.daemon.DelegationId.description: A delegation as a row of Delegation: its text is the run's id. A type of its own, not RunId, because a row is what the daemon reads of the run's record and files, not the run.

sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.title: DelegationPath
sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.description: How a delegation became a run (docs/model-routes.md, section 9): named (it named a protocol, and that runbook runs with the request as its intake), free (the free run, one agent node whose instruction is the request, writing result.md: asked for by the protocol delegation-free, or taken by a delegation that names no protocol on a daemon without a classifier route), classified (it named none, and one call on the classifier route picked a runbook of the daemon at or above the threshold of confidence, 0.8) or generated (the classifier's confidence was below it, and one call on the classifier route wrote a protocol of the daemon's parts, which the loader accepted) or change (it named a repository of the daemon's runbook.toml, `[repositories.<name>]`: the protocol delegation-change, one agent node working in the run's worktree of that repository, whose change the daemon commits and pushes as the branch runbook/<run-id> when the run delivers).

sdc.daemon.RouteName.title: RouteName
sdc.daemon.RouteName.description: The name of a model route the daemon declares (a table [routes.<name>] of its runbook.toml): one to 64 characters of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. A client names a route by it, never by an address, a token or an alias; the address, the token file and the prices stay in the daemon's file.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome
sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.description: Open text: the outcome name of the runbook's protocol for the root case, or one of the daemon's own causes (`orphaned`, `runtime-failure`, `stopped: route`, `failed: step <action> <end>`). The run's state is the closed set; the outcome is not.
